tweets.text:
We were delighted to host a welcome party for our new members — Ai Ishii, Rui Li, and Yanis Boukhoufane.
 Wishing them a wonderful start to their journey with RebelsNLU at JAIST, and many exciting research adventures ahead!

Wonderful time at @RebelsNLU last week as we hosted Dr. Ana Brassard from #TohokuNLP! She presented her work on evaluating LLMs’ commonsense reasoning and had thoughtful discussions with our members. Thanks again, Ana--your insights were truly inspiring!

We are excited to welcome our new students: Caraka Rahman, Lukas Hofbauer, Shohei Kitajima, Kobayashi Koga, and Mizuki Koyamagawa to RebelsNLU—your fresh perspectives will further strengthen our commitment to cutting-edge NLP research. (1.5/2)
